name: galaxy-memory
description: Infinite, semantically searchable long-term memory for AI coding agents — MCP server + interactive 3D knowledge graph

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @galaxy-memory/shared && npm run dev -w @galaxy-memory/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @galaxy-memory/shared && npm run build -w @galaxy-memory/mcp-server && npm run build -w @galaxy-memory/web
scripts.mcp: npm run build -w @galaxy-memory/shared -w @galaxy-memory/mcp-server && npm run start -w @galaxy-memory/mcp-server
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run build
